newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ANI says Palmer withdraws proposal.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ANI says Palmer withdraws proposal.

text.p: Australian National Industries Ltd (ANI) said on Tuesday that former director and shareholder Ross Palmer had withdrawn his proposal for an extraordinary general meeting to remove directors Peter Joseph and Howard Stack.
Joseph was instrumental in having Palmer dismissed from the board in a vote at last month's annual meeting.

Palmer clashed with Joseph over the board's handling of its investigation into the purchase of the Holter/ABT environmental engineering divisions in Germany. Palmer sold his stake of 40 million shares in ANI, or about five percent of the issued capital, last week. -- Sydney newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
